concepts.name: Miru
concepts.identity: Apricot-caramel curly poodle, huge round curly forelock, long floppy curly ears, golden amber eyes, cream muzzle and paw tips, little fluffy tail, teal collar and square gold tag. concepts.design: A complete adorable Frankenstein-monster alternate form. Tint the top curly forelock and outer ear curls muted mint-green while leaving the face's warm apricot fur and cream muzzle recognizable. Two short rounded silver costume bolts sit at the sides of a low charcoal neckband, clear of the ears. A charcoal-purple patchwork jacket with lime-green seams, oversized simple lapels, teal fabric patch and a torn-but-soft hem dresses the body; broad rounded dark boots encase only the back feet, the two original cream front paws remain visible. Two small decorative stitched lines are on fabric and one tiny mint forehead patch, never wounds. Original square gold tag anchors the jacket. Keep the original huge round amber eyes and a friendly little smile. The whole design must clearly read Frankenstein, not simply a dog wearing a normal jacket.

concepts.name: Happy
concepts.identity: Cream-white silky Maltese dog, long floppy straight-haired ears, high tied-up fountain ponytail with teal tie, big dark amber-brown eyes, black little button nose, smiling open mouth with pink tongue, small seated body, cream paws, fluffy curling plume tail at viewer right. Ghost transformation reads through its new flowing silhouette and subtle cyan edging; the cheerful silky white dog identity must remain unmistakable. No hidden face, no black eye holes replacing the original eyes, no detached floating objects.
